What persists, and how is a slot cleaned between customers?
Engineers onboarding to offstage and offstage cloud · Plane snapshot and archive; per-slot reset after work

LaunchDaemon as exla; outbound
calls only

offstage0–7, same Mac; reset per
customer

Fair claims per team; ack,
lost-box and timeout reaping

Accounts, keys, ledger,
tasks, boxes; logs, artifacts

Claim loop per slot,
heartbeats, reports, resets
slots

Runs builds, ops, gui agent,
GH runner as the slot user
Up to 2 s of state at risk

Snapshot every 2 s on one machine; a crash loses unsaved changes, a
failed write is only logged.

A slot that ran work is marked dirty; a failed reset keeps the mark and
retries with backoff.
